summary.en: Today AI (todayai.cn) as a magpie provider: phone-code or cookie sign-in, the account's mode/model tiers (Balanced, Power, DeepSeek, GLM), chat over Today's canonical message protocol (WebSocket push with HTTP polling fallback), and plan usage on the card.
summary.zh: 把 Today AI（todayai.cn）接进 magpie：手机验证码或 Cookie 登录，账号级档位（Balanced / Power / DeepSeek / GLM），通过 Today 的 canonical 消息协议跑对话（WebSocket 推送，断线自动退回轮询），卡片上显示套餐与每条额度。
